name: shell-ledger fake-money test
what: Three pretend accounts follow rules fixed in advance. No real money moves and no real orders are placed.

orders.written: before the entry week begins, New York time; a round whose orders are not written in time is skipped, never backfilled
orders.entry_day: the first trading day of the entry week

prices.source: Massive (formerly Polygon.io) grouped daily bars, not adjusted
prices.value_at: the day's closing price; a holding with no trade that day keeps its last closing price
prices.splits: share counts follow stock splits on the day they take effect
prices.dividends: cash dividends are added to the account on the ex-dividend day

group_buys.idea: buy companies where several insiders bought their own stock on the open market at about the same time
group_buys.rank: most insiders first, then most dollars

sector_tilt.idea: hold the funds of the three sectors where insider buying is most unusual compared with insider selling
sector_tilt.score: share of two-week stretches in the prior two years that this stretch's buying beats, minus the same share for selling
sector_tilt.weights: equal, reset at the open of every entry day

market.idea: buy one broad market fund on the first day and hold it

reading.weekly_difference: the account's weekly return minus the market account's, last close of each week
reading.statistic: mean weekly difference divided by its standard error
reading.ahead_if: the account ends above the market account and the statistic is at least 1.645
reading.behind_if: the account ends below the market account and the statistic is at most -1.645
reading.otherwise: no clear difference from the market
